text_description: A cropped runway look centered on a pale mint and white textured woven jacket with a boxy, slightly oversized straight silhouette, worn open over layered patterned pieces. The jacket is collarless or has a very low, clean neckline, with long relaxed sleeves and a hip-length hem; its surface is covered in an irregular black branch-like line motif, with scattered pale aqua fan shapes and light grey woven patterning. Multicolored braided trim in red, black, cream, and yellow outlines the front opening, cuffs, hem, and horizontal pocket edges, giving the structured jacket a richly embellished, handcrafted feel. Beneath it, a narrow vertical panel of dense red, black, white, and gold patterning is visible at the center front over a white underlayer, partly obscured by layered long necklaces with gold-tone chains, red accents, and a large circular pendant. The lower garment visible below the jacket appears to be a skirt or dress in a black-and-white grid/check pattern with bold red curved motifs and small floral-like color accents, creating a mixed-print contrast against the branch-printed jacket. Styling includes wet-looking dark hair, turquoise drop earrings, multiple rings, and a glimpse of a bright yellow handbag at the side; the overall mood is ornate, eclectic, and highly patterned with artisanal trim and layered jewelry.
